_comment: Reviews data. Aggregates and tags are pulled from the live Airbnb listing. Individual review TEXT (in 'items' below) is NOT public via Airbnb's API — open https://www.airbnb.fr/rooms/1021507317870791676/reviews on Airbnb, copy the most representative quotes, and paste them in. The example items below are placeholders.
_tags_comment: Top keywords reviewers mention, with how many reviews mention each. Ordered by count descending. Pulled live from Airbnb.

text.fr: [Exemple] Maison spacieuse et lumineuse, parfaite pour notre famille. L'accueil d'Edor était chaleureux et la localisation idéale pour visiter Paris.
text.en: [Sample] Spacious, bright house, perfect for our family. Edor was warm and welcoming and the location was ideal for visiting Paris.

text.fr: [Exemple] Tout était impeccable. Le jardin est un vrai plus, et la terrasse sur le toit est magnifique. Nous reviendrons !
text.en: [Sample] Everything was spotless. The garden is a real plus and the rooftop terrace is beautiful. We'll be back!

text.fr: [Exemple] Très belle maison, calme et confortable. Le RER B juste à côté permet de rejoindre Paris en 25 minutes.
text.en: [Sample] Lovely house, calm and comfortable. The RER B right nearby gets you into Paris in 25 minutes.
